name: Compass
tagline: An agent-driven dashboard that turns years of Kingston resident complaints into insight for citizens and the city.
problem: An open archive of community complaints exists, but residents and leaders lack tools to use it.
solution: A dashboard with an autonomous research agent that analyses the complaint dataset, clusters concerns and reports trends and priorities.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask the agent about a neighbourhood and get the top concerns with charts.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Started from research into what Kingston residents actually complain about.

lessons: Find the city's own open data before choosing the problem.
